notes: Both conjectures true: A227368(N) < A227368(N-1) exactly for even N in [s^2, s^2+2s], s even, and the sorted order is the product of these disjoint adjacent transpositions (2k-1,2k), k in A061887, so A227370 is an involution. Route: the Lean-proved pair/greedy model of A227786; first deviation of each candidate code from 1010... (sign and position phi = least odd >= k-D+1) picks k in {s-1,s,s+1}; tie-breaks by the run parity give the winners per block (L odd/even, s odd/even); consecutive codes compared group by group. Lean (partial): explicit-code comparisons of step 3 (pair_V_even, pair_O_odd, pair_V_odd, pair_O_even, cross_group) and min_struct (A227368(N) is the greedy code of a minimal-length pair). Outside Lean: which minimal-length pair wins (the winner table, step 2), cases E <= 3 and block boundaries, and the assembly into the A227370 statement; certificate/check.py verifies the case table, inversion set and b-files for N <= 3000.
